title: Finite open/direct-image endpoint coordinates
statement: At a finite compactification c and witnessed origin O, finite pushforward of the explicit open coordinate followed by the direct-image coordinate equals finiteImageIso at c followed by the inverse image of the realization-equivalence counit and fixedCompactModel at c. This is a single-endpoint naturality equation. No refinement, coefficient-composition hypothesis, or open-unit normalization is needed.

proof.text: Apply naturality of the finite open comparison and then of the separately derived direct-image comparison to the realization-equivalence counit. Paste their comparison squares with the associators. The resulting coordinate is exactly finiteImageIso followed by the inverse counit image and fixedCompactModel. This is the proved abstract endpoint_coordinates calculation.

theorem finiteFixedEndpointModelAt
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type w) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (n : ℕ)
    {X Y : Scheme.{w}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (O : FrobeniusExchange.CompactOrigin (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) X) :
    let A := Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)
    let R := PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    let e := sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A
    let K := e.inverse.obj O.K
    (PurCompactSupport.push R c.g).mapIso (finiteFixedOpenAt l E n c.i O) ≪≫
      (finiteFixedPushIso l E n c.g).app
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.openImmersionLowerShriek
          (ModuleCat.{w + 1} (ULift.{w + 1} A)) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) =
    (PurCompactSupport.finiteImageIso l E n c).app O.K ≪≫
      (sfIntrinsicCompactSupport c A).mapIso (e.counitIso.app O.K).symm ≪≫
      (FrobeniusExchange.fixedCompactModel A c).app K
